k-mascot.title: CoinGecko Gekko and Rex mascot coins
k-mascot.sourceSays: Posts say the Solana Foundation is backing CoinGecko and that its mascots Gekko and Rex are now Solana meme coins; some posts claim an acquisition, which is unverified.
k-mascot.reason: Nov 17 posts tie the coins to a Solana Foundation and CoinGecko announcement and to CoinGecko's mascots (Gekko, Rex); GEKKO's pool opened after it. Acquisition claims are unverified; call-group posts ignored.
